decision.numerics: bitwise identical at operator and two-update training level
decision.rationale: 0.7 percent device saving does not survive the host-side cost it introduces; carrying a Triton kernel, a runtime model patch and a determinism-flag workaround for a measured net loss is not justified
decision.verdict: reject due to insufficient performance benefit
